notes: In-app update check file (Phase 2 Item 3). versionCode hi compare ki key hai: app tabhi 'naya version' batayegi jab ye number installed versionCode se bada ho. APK seedha download channel (Supabase public bucket flora-apk) abhi pending hai — isliye apkUrl + sha256 khali hain aur app website ke download page par bhejega. Bucket + upload lagte hi isi file me apkUrl + sha256 bharna hai (ek chhota web push); app badle bina update chalu ho jayega. GitHub releases private-repo ki wajah se no-auth channel nahi; Vercel free 50 MB limit ki wajah se APK host nahi kar sakta.
